Provides a resource to manage TKE cluster extra args configuration.

> **NOTE:** This resource must exclusive in one cluster, do not declare additional args resources of this extra args elsewhere.

```typescript
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.kubernetes.ClusterExtraArgsConfig("example", {
    clusterId: "cls-man1vvi2",
    kubeApiservers: [
        "goaway-chance=0",
        "kubelet-preferred-address-types=Hostname",
    ],
    kubeControllerManagers: ["concurrent-serviceaccount-token-syncs=5"],
    kubeSchedulers: ["kube-api-qps=50"],
});
```

## Import



TKE cluster extra args config can be imported using the clusterId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Kubernetes/clusterExtraArgsConfig:ClusterExtraArgsConfig example cls-man1vvi2
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
